messages:
maya_chen: quick sync — weekly health check for NovusRetail after rv2q canary rollout (Mon)
liam_ortiz: model mix update — rv2q adoption ~48%, rv1 ~52% as of this morning
maya_chen: noticed fallback rate jump to 4.8% (baseline ~0.6%) since canary increase to 50% :eyes:
sanjay_patel: digging into logs now — spike comes with long-context requests (>2k tokens). seeing kv cache errors and occasional 500s. sample log:
```
2026-02-25T14:03:21Z rv2q serve error: kv_cache_overflow ctx_len=2540 req_id=abc-472
```
liam_ortiz: p50 latency for rv2q is fine, but p95 moved 220ms -> 410ms for rv2q-routed requests
maya_chen: weekly spend is +17% WoW, correlated with retry/fallback traffic and longer generation windows
aisha_ng: flagged renewal risk if perf doesn't stabilize before next cycle. customer reported better short prompt quality but inconsistent long-form output
maya_chen: proposed immediate actions: 1) reduce rv2q routing to 20% canary, 2) enable automatic fallback to rv1 on KV errors, 3) turn on cache warmup for known prompt prefixes, 4) schedule enablement call w/ customer to recommend prompt trimming
sanjay_patel: agree. I'll implement routing change + fallback rule. Fallback metric: `rv2q_kv_fallback` will be emitted for dashboarding
liam_ortiz: I'll prep a short playbook for the CSM to run during the call (tips: prompt length guardrails, batching knobs, suggested quantization tolerance notes)
maya_chen: @sanjay_patel can you roll back to 20% and add fallback rule? also add an alert on rv2q fallback rate >1% over 1h
sanjay_patel: on it. routing policy update queued. adding alert and metric now
deploy-bot: deploy started: routing-change v1.3 -> set rv2q weight 20% (job 98765)
liam_ortiz: I'll update the NovusRetail account playbook and CSM notes mentioning observed tradeoffs and temporary mitigations
maya_chen: I'll book a 30min enablement call with Novus success lead for tomorrow 10:00 PT, goals: review mitigations + collect qualitative feedback
aisha_ng: capture in renewal tracker: note = "model mix rollout caused KV fallbacks on long-form flows; mitigations in progress"
sanjay_patel: routing change live (3m), fallback rule added, metrics reporting to dashboards. will monitor 24h and send a digest
maya_chen: thanks team. next check-in Fri EOD to confirm metrics. owners: routing/fallback - @sanjay_patel, playbook & enablement - @liam_ortiz, customer comms - @maya_chen :thumbsup:
